I’m going to audit these by comparing the core daemon logic in `./cradle finish/family bridge finish/bridge-daemon-1.mjs` against `./scripts/bridge-daemon.mjs` to see where the divergence is causing the environment to choke.

I'll start by reading the daemon file from the cradle to see what that "standalone" version looks like.
